verses.1: In desperation, he will seek to be separated from all his possessions.
verses.2: He will not run away like a fool in the midst of confusion, when his heart is revealed.
verses.3: When the wicked come in, they also bring shame and disgrace with them.
verses.4: Deep waters; words spoken by a man’s mouth. A stream that flows away from the wisdom of a wise person.
verses.5: It is not good to turn the face of the wicked towards the righteous in judgment.
verses.6: The lips of the fool will bring forth words of strife, and his mouth will speak lies.
verses.7: His mouth is dumb, and his lips are heavy with sorrow.
verses.8: The words of Nirgan were like flames; they descended into the depths of darkness.
verses.9: And in his work, he also becomes a destroyer. He is indeed a man of destruction.
verses.10: From the mountain of God’s name, there will rise a righteous man who is blessed.
verses.11: Hon is rich, but his strength and power have been weakened by his own actions.
verses.12: Before honor, it becomes a source of pride for a person; but before shame, it becomes a source of humiliation.
verses.13: It is said that a word should be spoken before it can be heard by him.
verses.14: A person’s spirit can cure their illness; but whose spirit can be carried away?
verses.15: A foolish heart will gain knowledge; and with the ears of wise men, one can seek wisdom.
verses.16: May God make him grow larger, and may he be honored before the great ones.
verses.17: The first righteous person is one who fights against his enemies and also seeks to help them.
verses.18: From Midian will come the punishment for the wicked, and among the trees, it will be separated.
verses.19: My brother is a sinner, born of evil and wickedness; he is like a fugitive from Armon.
verses.20: From the fruit of a man’s mouth, his belly shall rejoice; the sound of his words shall be pleasing to him.
verses.21: Death and life are in the hands of the serpent, and her love will be consumed by her own fruit.
verses.22: He found a wife; he found what was good. Then he fulfilled Jehovah’s desires.
verses.23: The rich man will answer, and the poor man will be honored.
verses.24: A man who is hostile to others, and there’s also someone who loves his brother dearly.
